description_hook: Pointing only gets a guess. Two small words at the front turn it into a sentence anyone understands. Say I want with us, out loud.

scenes.narration: Which is the sentence? I want water, or just water? I want water.

scenes.narration: We learned please, with the ball, the rice, the window. Pass the ball, please!

scenes.narration: At the fruit bowl: can I have an orange, please?

scenes.narration: We learned can I have: glue, orange, trike, cup. Can I have it, please?

description_hook: A sentence can carry the reason with it. One word does that job, and grown ups stop guessing. Say because with us.

characters.name: Parth
characters.description: five years old, straight fringe, red raincoat, yellow rubber boots

scenes.narration: We learned because: muddy boots, the plant, the butter. Muddy boots, because it rained!

description_hook: Learn how to ask politely for dinner table condiments during family meals today.

scenes.narration: Today we will learn how to ask politely for dinner table items.
scenes.caption: आज हम रात के खाने की मेज़ पर वस्तुओं के लिए विनम्रता से माँगना सीखेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A dining room family table laden with dishes under warm chandelier lighting

scenes.narration: The polite meal request is, please pass the salt, please pass the salt.
scenes.caption: भोजन का विनम्र अनुरोध है, कृपया नमक आगे बढ़ा दीजिए, कृपया नमक बढ़ा दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A child's finger tracing printed text cards showing dining table request phrases

scenes.narration: When you need the shaker near your family dinner plates, you say please pass the salt.
scenes.caption: जब आपको अपने पारिवारिक डिनर प्लेटों के पास शेकर चाहिए, तो कहें कृपया नमक बढ़ा दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A four-year-old boy reaching toward the salt shaker politely while speaking

scenes.narration: Say the polite meal request aloud with me right now: Please pass the salt.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ अभी ऊँची आवाज़ में बोलिए: कृपया नमक आगे बढ़ा दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A four-year-old boy smiling politely, inviting the viewer to repeat the dinner request

scenes.narration: Please pass the salt.
scenes.caption: कृपया नमक आगे बढ़ा दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A clear speech bubble floating above showing the dining request in bold text

scenes.narration: You can ask to pass a basket of bread, or request a bowl of rice.
scenes.caption: आप ब्रेड की टोकरी आगे बढ़ाने के लिए कह सकते हैं या चावल के कटोरे का अनुरोध कर सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A split picture showing a basket of warm bread rolls beside a bowl of rice

scenes.narration: Which request is polite: please pass the salt or grab it fast? That is right, please pass the salt!
scenes.caption: कौन सा अनुरोध विनम्र है: कृपया नमक बढ़ा दीजिए या जल्दी से लो? बिल्कुल सही, कृपया!
scenes.image_brief: A quiz screen displaying the polite request on the left and a cross mark on the right

scenes.narration: We practiced asking politely for salt and dinner items at family meals. Please pass the salt.
scenes.caption: हमने पारिवारिक भोजन के समय नमक और अन्य वस्तुओं के लिए विनम्रता से माँगना सीखा।
scenes.image_brief: The family table glowing softly with the dining request displayed in center frame

description_hook: Learn how to express gratitude warmly when receiving birthday gifts today.

scenes.narration: Today we will learn how to express gratitude warmly when receiving gifts.
scenes.caption: आज हम उपहार प्राप्त करते समय गर्मजोशी से आभार व्यक्त करना सीखेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A birthday party gift table decorated with colorful ribbons and wrapping paper under bright lights

scenes.narration: The grateful thank you is, thank you for the gift, thank you for the gift.
scenes.caption: कृतज्ञता भरा धन्यवाद है, उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद, उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद।
scenes.image_brief: A small hand pointing to printed text cards showing gift gratitude phrases

scenes.narration: When an aunt hands you a beautifully wrapped birthday box, you say thank you for the gift.
scenes.caption: जब कोई चाची आपको सुंदर ढंग से लिपटा हुआ जन्मदिन का डिब्बा दे, तो कहें उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद।
scenes.image_brief: A six-year-old girl smiling happily while accepting a wrapped gift box from an adult

scenes.narration: Say the grateful thank you aloud with me right now: Thank you for the gift.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ अभी ऊँची आवाज़ में बोलिए: उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद।
scenes.image_brief: A six-year-old girl holding the gift box, speaking aloud with a grateful, festive smile

scenes.narration: Thank you for the gift.
scenes.caption: उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद।
scenes.image_brief: A clear speech bubble floating above showing the gift gratitude in bold text

scenes.narration: You can thank someone for a handmade drawing, or show appreciation for a toy.
scenes.caption: आप किसी हस्तनिर्मित चित्र के लिए धन्यवाद दे सकते हैं या खिलौने के लिए सराहना दिखा सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A split graphic showing a handmade greeting card beside a toy race car box

scenes.narration: Which phrase shows gratitude: thank you for the gift or throw it away? That is right, thank you for the gift!
scenes.caption: कौन सा वाक्यांश आभार दिखाता है: उपहार के लिए धन्यवाद या इसे फेंक दो? बिल्कुल सही!
scenes.image_brief: A quiz card displaying the gift gratitude on the left and a cross mark on the right

scenes.narration: We practiced expressing gratitude warmly for birthday presents and gift boxes. Thank you for the gift.
scenes.caption: हमने जन्मदिन के उपहारों और डिब्बों के लिए गर्मजोशी से आभार व्यक्त करना सीखा।
scenes.image_brief: The gift table glowing softly with the gratitude phrase displayed in center frame
